rawContent: From the beginning @hannahpaasch and I have been clear that the #churchtoo movement lives and breathes outside of us. It has to for the work to be effective. Not only that but it only exists because of the work of @TaranaBurke and the #metoo movement, by which it was inspired.

Which is hilarious because for the first six months #churchtoo existed publications like Christianity Today and others did nothing but publish articles about “evangelicalism’s #metoo moment” WITHOUT using the #churchtoo tag because they were so petrified of us.
Can’t speak for the #MeToo movement as a whole but the #ChurchToo movement certainly has no use for people who believe in the Billy Graham rule! Lol
Small thing but it’s interesting to me how the “GC2 Summit on #ChurchToo/#MeToo” appears to have changed its name in the last few weeks as a response to the outcry on here… https://t.co/nS8twiBDqu

In a little less than a month, a bunch of mostly-conservative Evangelical voices will be gathering at the Billy Graham Center at Wheaton College in Illinois to discuss what the #ChurchToo/#MeToo movement has to do with Christianity and "respond" to the problem of sexual violence.
